title: Google Women Techmakers Scholarship
shortDescription: A scholarship designed to support women pursuing degrees in technology and computing. Includes financial support, mentorship, and networking opportunities with Google professionals.
contentDescription:
The Global Future Leaders Fellowship offers an intensive leadership development journey focused on cross-cultural collaboration and social innovation. Participants will engage with world-renowned mentors, attend global seminars, and develop actionable community projects.

All travel, accommodation, and tuition expenses are fully covered by the program. Fellows also receive a monthly stipend to support living costs during the fellowship period. 

Graduates of the program join a thriving alumni network of over 2,000 changemakers across 70+ countries, gaining lifelong mentorship and collaboration opportunities.
eligibilityCriteria: Open to women currently enrolled in undergraduate or graduate programs in computer science, software engineering, or related technical fields.

title: Adobe Design Circle Scholarship
shortDescription: Provides financial support and mentorship to students passionate about pursuing careers in design, including UX, motion graphics, and illustration.
contentDescription:
The TechWomen Africa Fellowship brings together promising women innovators from across Africa to collaborate with top tech companies and mentors. Fellows gain exposure to emerging technologies, leadership training, and networking opportunities.

The program covers tuition and accommodation costs, while participants are responsible for partial travel expenses. Limited travel grants are available for outstanding applicants.

Beyond the program, fellows continue to receive mentorship support and career guidance through the TechWomen Africa alumni network.
eligibilityCriteria: Open to undergraduate students aged 18–25 with a portfolio demonstrating creativity and design thinking.
benefits: Global exposure via Adobe’s creative community

title: Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program
shortDescription: A fully funded scholarship for talented African students committed to driving positive change in their communities through leadership and innovation.
contentDescription:
The Sustainable Design Innovation Challenge invites participants to submit impactful design concepts that address real-world environmental challenges. Teams will receive mentorship and exposure to industry experts.

While the program does not provide financial assistance, selected finalists gain access to professional visibility, portfolio support, and opportunities to present at international design forums.

This initiative encourages innovation, collaboration, and global awareness within the design community, inspiring action for a sustainable future.
eligibilityCriteria: Open to African students aged 18–30 with strong academic records and demonstrated leadership potential.

title: UNICEF Innovation Fellowship
shortDescription: The UNICEF Innovation Fellowship offers young professionals an opportunity to contribute to real-world humanitarian tech projects, focusing on sustainability and inclusion.
contentDescription:
